claim.quote: These results set the most stringent direct-detection constraint to date on the WIMP-proton spin-dependent cross section at 3.4 $\times$ 10$^{-41}$ cm$^2$ for a 30-GeV$\thinspace$c$^{-2}$ WIMP, more than one order of magnitude improvement from previous PICO results.

key_value.note: Spin-dependent WIMP-proton limit at 30 GeV/c^2; the abstract gives no confidence level.

name: Dark Matter Search Results from the PICO-60 C$_3$F$_8$ Bubble Chamber

summary.plain: PICO-60 refilled with 52 kg of C3F8 saw no dark-matter-like events in a blind analysis, and set the strongest limit then on dark matter that couples to the spin of the proton.
summary.technical: 52 kg C3F8; blind analysis of an efficiency-corrected 1167 kg-day exposure at a 3.3 keV thermodynamic threshold (taken November 2016-January 2017) reveals no single-scattering nuclear-recoil candidates, consistent with the predicted background; limit 3.4e-41 cm^2 for a 30 GeV/c^2 WIMP (Phys. Rev. Lett. 118, 251301). The abstract does not state the confidence level.

title: Dark Matter Search Results from the PICO-60 C$_3$F$_8$ Bubble Chamber
why_it_matters: The abstract states the limit is the most stringent direct-detection constraint to date and more than one order of magnitude better than previous PICO results.
